# Source of truth: ~/.config/zsh/environment.sh # ~/.zshenv sources the same file, so shells and GUI apps see # identical XDG values without duplicating definitions. . "$HOME/.config/zsh/environment.sh"
for v in XDG_CONFIG_HOME XDG_CACHE_HOME XDG_DATA_HOME XDG_STATE_HOME XDG_BIN_HOME XDG_RUNTIME_DIR GNUPGHOME; do eval "launchctl setenv $v \"\$$v\"" done
mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" chmod 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
